prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Use quick keyboard shortcuts or right-click to interact anytime.", "Right-click your pet to bring up interactions, hide, or change settings."]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Learn the essential shortcuts to summon, move, and talk with your pet directly on your desktop taskbar and screen.", "Got It!"]
2: ["Choose Your Perfect Companion", "Swipe through available pets to preview their animations and unique behaviors.", "Most Playful"]
3: ["Test Your Pet's Voice", "Listen to your pet's greetings and sound effects before making it official.", "Sounds Great!"]
4: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or create your custom pet from scratch.", "Instant Companion vs Custom Creator"]
5: ["Save Your Companion to Cloud", "Sign in to securely sync your pet across sessions so you never lose your progress."]
6: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "If your pet doesn't appear immediately, check your system tray or press Ctrl+Shift+P to bring them forward.", "Start Playing"]
7: ["Signing in binds your adopted pet to this account permanently. Use your primary login to avoid duplicate accounts."]
8: ["Preparing Desktop Sandbox...", "We are getting your companion's home ready. This only takes a short moment!"]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Verified!", "Congratulations! Your companion is officially registered and ready to move onto your desktop.", "Certified Companion Owner"]
